what_to_detect: A fused casting of a split card with fuse is playable from its owner's hand.
near_miss: A fused casting of the split card from another zone is not playable.
record_fields: the candidate's acting line, the Fuse keyword line

what_to_detect: A fused split spell on the stack has the colours of both halves.
near_miss: One half of a split card cast alone has only that half's colours.
record_fields: cost-half snapshot entity of state.refs.source on the stack, its colors
gen-3 card lines[].cast_with (the Fuse keyword line)

what_to_detect: A fused casting of a split card is affordable when its controller can pay both halves' mana costs together.
near_miss: A fused casting that is not affordable because the available mana covers only one half.
record_fields: the candidate's acting line, the Fuse keyword line

what_to_detect: A fused split spell's resolution performs the left half's instructions and then the right half's.
near_miss: One half of a split card cast alone performs only that half's instructions.
record_fields: payload events in order and their attributed_to chain index
gen-3 card lines[].cast_with (the Fuse keyword line)
